Welcome to RenoLogic

Before we begin, it's important to understand exactly what this platform does — and what it doesn't do.

RenoLogic IS

  • A structured record of your renovation project
  • A place to track milestones and evidence
  • A way to manage your contractor relationship
  • An immutable audit trail for 7 years

RenoLogic is NOT

  • A payment processor
  • A dispute resolution service
  • A guarantor of contractor work quality
  • A holder or releaser of funds
RenoLogic is a system of record only. It does not hold, release, or process funds. All financial arrangements are between you and your chosen escrow provider.

How job posting works

Posting a job on RenoLogic is straightforward. Here's what you need to know.

No budget or pricing fields

Jobs have no budget or pricing fields — this is intentional. Pricing is introduced only after you select a contractor.

Describe the work, location, and trade

Provide the scope of work, your suburb, postcode, and the type of trade required.

Contractors signal interest — not bids

Contractors browse open jobs and express interest. They do not quote or submit pricing at this stage.

No messaging before selection

There is no messaging between you and a contractor before you formally select one.

RenoLogic is a system of record only. It does not hold, release, or process funds.

Selecting a contractor

Selecting a contractor is the most significant action you'll take on this platform. Read this carefully.

Permanently recorded
Selecting a contractor is a permanently recorded event with a timestamp and cannot be undone.
Cannot be reversed without administrator intervention
If you select a contractor in error, reversal requires contacting RenoLogic support and logging a documented correction.
Does not constitute a contract
Selecting a contractor unlocks the quoting process only. No contract exists until a quote is accepted.
No rankings or recommendations
The platform does not rank, score, or recommend contractors.
RenoLogic is a system of record only. It does not hold, release, or process funds.

Escrow & payments

RenoLogic is not a payment platform. Here's exactly what we record and what we don't touch.

What the platform records
Reference data only
  • The name of your escrow provider
  • Your escrow reference ID
What the platform does NOT do
Outside our scope
  • Hold any funds
  • Release any funds
  • Confirm whether escrow is funded
  • Connect to your escrow provider
All financial arrangements — funding escrow, releasing funds, and payment — occur directly between you and your escrow provider, outside of RenoLogic.
RenoLogic is a system of record only. It does not hold, release, or process funds.

    How RenoLogic works for you

    Your end-to-end journey on the platform.

    1
    Browse open jobs
    Homeowners post jobs describing their renovation. You browse and filter by trade and location.
    2
    Signal interest — not a bid
    Click 'Express Interest' on any open job. No pricing, no quote, no messaging at this stage.
    3
    Wait for homeowner selection
    The homeowner reviews who has expressed interest and selects a firm. You are notified if selected.
    4
    Submit a quote
    Once selected, you unlock the Quote Builder. Define your quote and milestones with full pricing.
    5
    Homeowner accepts or declines
    The homeowner reviews and accepts or declines. Both outcomes are final and permanently recorded.
    6
    Deliver, track, and record
    Upload evidence, mark milestones complete, record payments, manage to handover.
    You do not submit pricing or quotes before the homeowner selects your firm. No pricing is visible to any party before selection.
    RenoLogic is a record-keeping platform only. It does not hold, process, or release funds, and does not provide legal, financial, or dispute resolution services.

    Bring your own homeowner

    Already have a client lined up? Send them a direct invite — they sign up to RenoLogic linked to your firm, skip the public job posting, and go straight into your quote workflow.

    CHANNEL A
    Browse open jobs
    Public marketplace — homeowners post, you express interest, they choose.
    · Competing with other firms
    · Homeowner controls selection
    CHANNEL B · NEW
    .
    Invite a homeowner directly
    Send a private link or QR. The homeowner is pre-attached to your firm — no marketplace step.
    Skip Express Interest — go straight to quote
    HOW A DIRECT INVITE WORKS
    1
    Project details
    Title, trade, location and scope — internal-only until invite.
    2
    Add milestones
    Break the work into milestones with values — total auto-calculates.
    3
    Quote & invite
    Set GST, expiry, then send via email or QR with the homeowner's details.
    4
    Homeowner accepts
    They sign up, auto-linked to your firm with the quote ready to review.
    WHAT AN INVITE LOOKS LIKE
    PROJECT INVITE — PREVIEW
    renologic.app/i/PB-CHEN-9F4K2
    Expires in 14 days
    Single-use
    Linked to Pacific Build Co
    Homeowner still creates their own account, accepts T&Cs, and verifies their identity.
    Quotes, milestones, and evidence rules are identical to the public channel — no shortcuts.
    Pricing is never visible inside the invite. The Quote Builder unlocks only after the homeowner accepts.
    Every invite (sent, opened, accepted, expired) is recorded in your audit log.

    Escrow and this platform

    Understand exactly what RenoLogic records — and what it does not do.

    What RenoLogic records

    • The name of your escrow provider (free text — you enter this)
    • An escrow reference ID per project (free text — you enter this)
    • That these fields were set, and when (audit logged)

    What RenoLogic does NOT do

    • Connect to or communicate with your escrow provider
    • Hold funds on behalf of either party
    • Release funds or trigger escrow releases
    • Validate whether escrow conditions are met
    • Display an escrow balance or fund status

    Where to find it: Escrow Provider Name and Escrow Reference ID fields appear on each job detail screen after the homeowner selects your firm. You can enter and update these at any time.

    RenoLogic is a record-keeping platform only. It does not hold, process, or release funds, and does not provide legal, financial, or dispute resolution services.
